  • 90cm Freestanding Electric Oven With Gas Cooktop, Stainless Steel

90cm Freestanding Electric Oven With Gas Cooktop, Stainless Steel

Fan Forced

Our fan forced function ensures that heat is more evenly distributed throughout the oven. Faster cooking times and lower energy consumption.

Large Capacity

Large capacity means more space, great for cooking multiple dishes.

Easy Slide Racks

Our chrome side rack system makes sliding the oven shelf and cooking tray in and out of the oven simple, safe and easy

Triple glazed doors

Little inquisitive fingers are kept safer through our triple glazed door and combined with the cavity cooling fan technology assists in keeping cooler door surface temperatures.
